title: Resource fallback for the H20-TABICL-FT fold-0 screen (allocator fix + reduced fine-tune row budget)
motivation: The first invocation of H20-TABICL-FT died WITHOUT producing any prediction or result file: epoch 1 of 10 completed its 51 meta-batches (per-batch time degraded 19s -> 63s, the allocator-fragmentation signature) and the process was then hard-killed at the end-of-epoch validation (no Python exception reached the runner's try/except, no FAILED JSON, no Windows application/OOM event, 19GB RAM free). Separately, the observed wall-clock (45min for ONE epoch) puts the full frozen recipe at ~7.5 GPU-h for this single fold-0 screen and ~37h for the prospective 5-fold follow-up, far beyond this prereg's own <=2 GPU-h budget and the campaign ceiling. A resource failure is NOT a measurement: the fine-tuning mechanism has still never been observed. These two changes are pure resource adaptations chosen before ANY fine-tuned prediction existed.

changes.allocator: PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True set before torch import (verified functional on the certified torch 2.11.0+cu128). This changes only how the CUDA caching allocator serves blocks; it cannot alter any computed value or prediction.
changes.train_rows: The fine-tune training set X_train is a stratified 100000-row subsample of FIT-train (per-class without-replacement draw, np.random.default_rng(20261011); proportional class counts). The inner validation split stays the FULL 55971-row stratified 10% of FIT from the original prereg, so the early-stopping metric and its 0.9586 pretrained baseline remain directly comparable. The eval fold (139927 rows) is untouched.
changes.rationale_rows: Training meta-batches are 10k-row chunks: 100k rows => 10 chunks/epoch => ~42min of training for all 10 epochs plus validations, inside the <=2 GPU-h budget. It also shrinks the end-of-epoch validation fit (100k-row context) and the final inference estimator (100k-row context at 8 estimators) to ~1/5 of what the full recipe intended, removing the memory-pressure point the first attempt died on.

unchanged: all other frozen_args of H20-TABICL-FT: epochs=10, learning_rate=1e-5, weight_decay=0.01, n_estimators_finetune=2, n_estimators_inference=8, max_data_size=10000, device=cuda
route view (22 features, label-free), eval fold 0, FIT-only training/validation, inner-split seed 20261010, classifier random_state 1201
the transformers LR-scheduler shim disclosure of the original prereg
champion hash-asserted references and all screen metrics
decision_rule: identical to H20-TABICL-FT (PROMISING = portfolio_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995; DECORRELATION_COLLAPSE = standalone improves but corr_vs_route >= 0.99; NEGATIVE = standalone fails to improve < +2e-3 over the 0.956343 zero-shot).
deviation_note: This is a REDUCED-DOSE arm (100k of 503k fine-tune rows). A NEGATIVE verdict closes reduced-dose supervised fine-tuning of TabICL at this data size; full-dose (503k rows, ~7.5 GPU-h/screen) remains unmeasured and resource-blocked under the current compute ceiling. A PROMISING verdict would still owe the full-dose arm, under a user-approved extended compute plan, before any OOF admission claim.
anti_leakage: unchanged from H20-TABICL-FT: subsample of FIT only, eval fold never seen, label-free view, no public-LB feedback.
